results.title: How to Build a Website with AI: Steps and Prompts (2026)
results.content:
Give every page a unique title and description that say what the page is about.
 Use one main heading per page, and headings that describe the sections below them.
 Add alt text to images that describes them.
 Make sure the site has a sitemap and isn't blocking search engines.
 For a local business, put your name, address and phone number in the same form everywhere.

Then keep the site alive after launch with new pages that answer what customers ask. Greta.sh's self-growing websites do part of this for you: Greta checks titles, descriptions and whether AI assistants can read the site and suggests fixes, and once publishing is switched on it can publish new articles on a schedule you approve.
